cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

mechanism: A treats a supposed pupil choosing between photographs as a concealed judgment of loyalty to its teacher.
confusable: The choice is graded for allegiance rather than image quality, but A keeps calling it professional advice.
comparison: Public image selection versus availability for a hypothetical move.
seedUse: D11 competing photos and attachment order supply small repeated tests; S05 turns neutral standards into supposed failed lessons.
